posts.title: New Year 2026
posts.description: Good Morning ALL! How are you this Wednesday morning? I am doing great. After a day of shopping with my friend Cynthia at West Edmonton Mall, I would have thought that I would have fallen asleep right away but that was not the case. I tossed and turned and turned and tossed. I think it was after 3:00 a.m. when I finally settled down and then of course, did not want to get up when the alarm went off at 7:00 a.m. Oh well, not like I have to be anywhere at a specific time today. My new eyeglasses are ready for pick up so I will go early afternoon to get them. I cannot wait to have them. We had a successful shopping day. I found everything on my list and a few things for me. I actually used several of my gift cards which was great. There were some people at the mall but not like on a weekend or into December. Most people were there for the “Black Friday” sales. I guess that is like a week long event. The decorations were up at the mall and I took a few photos along with a selfie of us girl
